The overview

Punta Cana is the Dominican Republic's beach capital — miles of palm-lined Caribbean coast, all-inclusive resorts and easy island adventures.

Top things to do in Punta Cana

  • Lounge on Bavaro Beach
  • Catamaran to natural pools
  • Zipline and buggy through the countryside
  • Snorkel offshore reefs
  • Day-trip to Saona Island

Best time to visit

The sweet spot for Punta Cana is generally Dec–Apr (dry) — and the cheapest fares often land just outside peak season.

Is it safe?

Resort areas generally safe. Watch your belongings in crowds and tourist areas, and check your government’s current advisory before you go. Visa for US passports: Visa-free (tourist card).

A bit of history

Hispaniola was the site of the first permanent European settlement in the Americas (1490s); Punta Cana itself developed from the 1970s as tourism took off.

Culture & language

Dominican culture is merengue and bachata, baseball, and friendly hospitality, with a Spanish-Caribbean rhythm to daily life.

Language: Spanish · English spoken: Common in resorts

Frequently asked questions

How much is a flight to Punta Cana?

The cheapest round-trip we're tracking to Punta Cana (PUJ) from the USA is about $210 right now. Live fares move through the day, so confirm the current price before you book.

When is the best time to visit Punta Cana?

The best time to fly to Punta Cana is generally Dec–Apr (dry). Shoulder-season trips often pair good weather with lower fares.

Is Punta Cana safe for tourists?

Resort areas generally safe. As anywhere, watch your belongings in crowds and check your government's current advisory before you go.

Do US citizens need a visa for Dominican Republic?

Visa for US passports: Visa-free (tourist card). Always confirm the latest entry rules with official sources before booking.
